title: Vivir en la colonia
goal: Read a synthesis of nearly three centuries of colonial life — longer than most of these countries have existed as independent states — and what actually held the system together.

items: State roughly how long the colonial period lasted and why that matters.
Name the three institutional pieces that held the system together.
Explain where much of today's colonial-city layout actually came from.
Explain why administration and hierarchy alone don't fully explain colonial life.
Use passive voice to synthesize several institutions in a single summary.
